name: Vanguard Five's astromech droid
description: An astromech droid was assigned to Vanguard Five some time after the Battle of Endor and flew with them whenever they were in an X-wing starfighter or a BTL Y-wing starfighter. This droid was present at the Incursion in the Bormea sector, the Battle of Yavin Prime, and the Strike on Esseles.
